manifests.contents:
[package]
name = "member-one"
version = "0.1.0"

[target.'cfg(unix)'.dependencies]
renamed_member = { workspace = true, optional = true, default-features = false, features = ["extra"] }

[dependencies]
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
git_dep = { git = "https://example.invalid/repo" }

[dev-dependencies]
pretty_assertions = "1"

[build-dependencies]
cc = "1"

lock_contents:
version = 4

[[package]]
name = "member-one"
version = "0.1.0"

name = "member-two"
